quote: Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers from any and all damages ... arising out of any claim that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade right secret of a third party
rationale: Indemnity omits MarketSite.net Service and third-party catalog content; absolute notice/tender conditions without prejudice qualifier; no Corio settlement consent; termination fallback allows revocation of the perpetual licence with only pro-rata refund; §8.2 exclusions are overbroad.

proposal.comment: Cap should be agreement-level with standard carve-outs and customer-credit pass-through.

AMOUNTS CORIO PAYS OR CREDITS ITS CUSTOMERS AS A RESULT OF COMMERCE ONE'S BREACH SHALL CONSTITUTE DIRECT DAMAGES.
ops.oldText: EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.

proposal.summary: Cap is transaction-level and effectively illusory; only Section 8 carved out — missing carve-outs for confidentiality, IP misuse, gross negligence/willful misconduct, payment; no super-cap; Customer credits may be excluded as consequential.
